semantic.justification: Reads the original ActiveTable property by sheet name from the primary saved view and emits the actual selected sheet in the indexed ODF view settings. Window, zoom and other view properties remain outside this mechanism. Reads and writes the native ShowGrid values independently at the workbook level and inside the Tables map keyed by sheet name. Uses the native HasColumnRowHeaders and ShowZeroValues ODS view booleans. Formula display has no native reader or writer entry. Reads and writes the signed integer CursorPositionX and CursorPositionY properties in the named sheet’s ODF view record. J0Z0KF worksheet pane checkpoint. Reads native short pane modes and pane IDs, signed column coordinates, pixel and twip forms, and property order. The browser stores normal split lengths in physical twips and uses the matching properties recognized by the native reader. Uses native PositionLeft and PositionBottom for the unsplit origin and writes the default inactive top position when no vertical split exists. Reads the original TableSelected boolean in ODF view settings while retaining the native output omission. Carries the native HasSheetTabs and IsOutlineSymbolsSet booleans through the primary ODF view sequence. Persists ShowPageBreaks through the native primary view sequence. The primary ODS view carries drawing-grid resolution, subdivisions, snap, visibility and synchronization with native signed XML scalars. It also carries note, author, formula-mark and value-highlighting flags. The named sheet view accepts legacy TabColor while the writer persists the color in the table style.
